name: Calendly
prompt: Build a scheduling app with: user sets weekly availability (day/time slots), public booking page at /book/:username, visitor picks a slot and enters name/email, confirmation email via Resend, bookings stored in SQLite, admin view of upcoming/past bookings, and timezone support. No calendar sync needed for v1.
notes: Cal.com exists and is excellent. A basic booking page is one of the easiest SaaS apps to vibecode.
